sections.title: Mini Bio
sections.body: I am a Software Engineer and a Full Stack Developer in development! - 🔭 I’m studying to become a Software Engineer at 42 School Berlin. - 🌱 Always as possible into the wild! - 🦆 In my free time I meditate, read macroeconomics articles and watch quanthum physics videos. - ⚡ Moving over 40+ countries and 170+ cities in the last 5y. - 🐧 Not following the sun!
